about_the_game:
Kana no Mado – Plus

Unlock the complete Japanese reading experience.

With Kana no Mado – Plus, you unlock every learning and practice mode: go beyond the kana basics and master real reading, vocabulary, stats, and more.

No pressure. Just you, the characters, and your own pace.

What’s included:

  • All learning modes:

    Access exclusive lessons for reading kana side-by-side, identifying look-alike characters, and practicing with real Japanese words (kana and kanji), all with native audio.

  • Full quiz access:

    Practice without limits: unlock mixed kana quizzes, vocabulary quizzes (with JLPT level selection), listening challenges, and more – all supporting your preferred display font.

  • Vocabulary modes:

    Practice reading with beginner words written only in kana, or challenge yourself with JLPT N5–N1 vocabulary shown with kanji, furigana, romaji, and translations. Every word is fully voiced.

  • Detailed stats and custom sessions:

    Track your learning, set your session length, choose vocabulary level, and focus on what matters to you.

  • Clean and focused design:

    Available in English, French, German, Spanish, and Simplified Chinese. Designed for mouse, keyboard, touch, and controller.

Every word and character voiced by a native Japanese speaker

Enjoy clear, easy-to-understand pronunciation, every kana and every word was specially recorded for Kana no Mado by a female native speaker.

Open the window to Japanese.

Whether you’re starting from scratch or building on your skills, Kana no Mado – Plus helps you read faster, remember longer, and enjoy learning.
